The background contains faint, nonsensical script-like patterns that resemble AI-generated hallucinations of text or mathematical formulas, contributing to an unnatural aesthetic.
The boundary between the ball and the background is soft and indistinct, with the texture of the ball seemingly bleeding into the background texture.
